text:
Samir (Solutions): kicking off thread for CLIENTX POC — need alignment on hosting mode, success metrics, and any red flags from security.
Elaine P. (Sales Eng): quick TL;DR from kickoff: fintech use case, document summarization + redaction, ~1000 daily active sessions, target p95 latency ~200ms, strict EU data residency requirement.
Matt (AE): timeline ask from customer: 8-week POC, want go/no-go decision at week 6. Budgeted for a short dedicated eval if needed. They also asked about pricing for burst/Dedicated vs Hosted for the POC.
Priya R. (Security): residency + encryption: they need EU-hosted keys, audit logs, and SOC2 attestations. Also asked if we can put private control plane on customer VPC for the POC — likely yes but need checklist.
Devon (Infra): short answer: Hosted (EU region) can meet residency for data-in-transit + at-rest w/ EU infra, but keys live in our KMS unless we do Private with customer-managed KMS. Dedicated gives isolation but still uses Redwood control plane unless Private.
Samir (Solutions): main decision drivers: 1) residency/keys 2) latency SLO 3) cost for 8-week run and any uplift for dedicated reserved capacity. Customer leans Hosted for speed unless keys are blockers.
Elaine P. (Sales Eng): proposed success criteria to confirm with customer:
- Functional: summarization accuracy >= 85% (measured on 200 eval prompts)
- Privacy: no PHI leakage on a 100-case redaction test
- Performance: p95 latency <= 200ms in EU region for 99% of traffic during 50rps simulated workload
- Cost: 8-week POC total tokens <$5k (ballpark) or alternative: predictable Dedicated cap commit quote
Priya R. (Security): add: must have audit log retention 90 days and ability to pull request-level lineage for 30 sample requests.
Matt (AE): on pricing — i'll ask finance for a short Dedicated POC quote (2 GPUs reserved, 8 weeks) vs Hosted usage estimate. Customer likely accepts small reserved commit if it simplifies SLA.
Devon (Infra): technical note: for Dedicated POC we recommend these configs:
```
model: gpt-open-7b-quant
region: eu-west-1
gpu_pool: 2xA10G
batching: dynamic, max_tokens_per_batch: 4096
kv_cache: enabled
```
This matches their expected session lengths and keeps p95 low.
Samir (Solutions): eval plan snippet to run during week 2-4 (we should send to customer):
- 200 labelled prompts for summarization (gold labels)
- 100 redaction cases with edge PII
- 1 load test: 50rps steady for 30 minutes + 200 rps burst 2 mins
- monitoring hooks: token breakdown, model fallback rate, cache hit rate
Elaine P. (Sales Eng): for Hosted vs Dedicated decision matrix i'll include:
- Hosted (EU): fastest to spin up, usage billing, keys in Redwood KMS (option to bring-your-own via Private only)
- Dedicated: isolated GPUs, can meet p95 at lower cost if sustained traffic, reserved commit required
- Private: necessary if customer requires customer-managed KMS / air-gapped control plane
Priya R. (Security): red flags: if they require HSM-backed keys under their control we must go Private. Otherwise Hosted w/ contractual KMS controls may be acceptable.
Matt (AE): action items for this thread:
- Matt: ask finance for Dedicated POC quote + hosted cost estimate by EOD Thurs
- Samir: share eval prompt set and template for accuracy metrics by tomorrow
- Devon: confirm EU region capacity availability for 2xA10G for those dates
- Priya: prepare short answers for security questionnaire items re: KMS, audit logs, and data residency
Samir (Solutions): sample wording i'll send to customer for success criteria confirmation (short):
"POC success = meets functional accuracy thresholds, passes redaction audits, meets latency SLO in EU region, and fits within the mutually agreed budget for 8-week trial." 
Elaine P. (Sales Eng): also flagging: customer asked about model fallback behavior if capacity constrained. We should offer automatic fallback to a slightly smaller model with graceful degradation. Example policy below:
```
policy:
  - primary: gpt-open-7b-quant (eu-west-1)
  - fallback: gpt-open-6b-quant
  - max_latency_fallback: 300ms
  - fallback_rate_limit: 10% per minute
```
Devon (Infra): capacity note: if we schedule Dedicated POC we can guarantee the pool, otherwise Hosted has a risk window during EU maintenance — set expected maintenance blackout window in SOW.
Priya R. (Security): i'll draft a one-page appendix on residency/KMS options and what triggers Private, send for reviews.
Matt (AE): thanks all — i'll loop in the customer with proposed success criteria + ask if BYOK is a must. ping me if anything else to add. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window notice: eu-west-1 infra updates planned in 7 days (low impact). See https://status.redwood.ai/ for details.
Samir (Solutions): noted — we'll include a mitigation plan if maintenance overlaps with their load test window. End of thread.
